provenance_note: Hand-authored; no tenant contacted. Page 2 of 2, and it carries two deliberate probes. (1) BILL-ERP-1003 was modified AFTER the window's until bound: Zoho's last_modified_time filter is one-sided -- 'search bills modified after a specific time' -- so there is no upper-bound parameter and the adapter must drop this row locally, or a poll silently ingests documents from outside the window it checkpointed. (2) sub_total 5000.005 sits exactly on a half-paise boundary, so it proves the money path rounds half-up through Decimal rather than through binary float, which is the AUD-H-007 defect.
